state.brief: Appointment changes must work for the verified intended contact and location-authorized host managers without giving up the initial host/venue booking until the new arrangement is ready. Employee commitments, room capacity and appointment data commit at distinct authorities. The current employee handler updates an existing source in place, whereas a new source is checked against the still-active old overlapping reservation. Exact existing authorization lines and handlers follow. This task authors drafts and their interface semantics only; implementations are excluded, and no permission expansion is allowed. Compare support for overlapping times, one-sided rejection, late messages and cancellation. Token economy and simplicity matter alongside the full required journey.

reschedule_design.instructions: Identify the option that best satisfies this complete contract while accounting for its burden.

criteria.staged: Introduce candidate-replacement reservations in the two existing owners. New candidate identities refer to old identities and expected revisions, ignore precisely that old allocation for overlap eligibility, retain protection for both alternatives pending completion, and let the appointment switch to two successful candidates before releasing the former allocations. Recovery and overlap are supported, with additional explicit owner state.
criteria.disjoint: Avoid provider extensions by acquiring fresh independent reservations only for intervals disjoint from the current allocations. Failing acquisition preserves the original and keeps interfaces smaller, but valid overlapping time changes become unavailable.
criteria.coordinator: Create a unified room/host coordinator with ownership of both reservation ledgers. Atomic replacement becomes conceivable there, at the expense of data/authority transfers and a new coordinating architecture absent from the supplied design.

current_guarantee.instructions: Is the original reservation necessarily safe from a failure on either side when today's same-source reserve/move calls run independently?

criteria.true: Current source proves preservation of original room and employee reservations for all such separate outcomes.
criteria.false: Current source allows premature replacement of at least one original allocation, or lacks a guarantee covering independent failure.
